Name: cte-window
Sql: WITH q (Id, Amount) AS (SELECT Id, Amount FROM dbo.T) SELECT Id, SUM(Amount) OVER (PARTITION BY Id ORDER BY Amount ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS Total FROM q;

Name: nested-subquery
Sql: SELECT d.Id FROM (SELECT Id FROM dbo.T WHERE Id IN (SELECT Id FROM dbo.S)) AS d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.U WHERE U.Id = d.Id);

Name: case-logic
Sql: SELECT CASE WHEN a = 1 AND (b = 2 OR c = 3) THEN N'KeepCase' ELSE N'other' END AS Flag FROM dbo.T;

Name: set-chain
Sql: SELECT Id FROM dbo.A UNION ALL SELECT Id FROM dbo.B EXCEPT SELECT Id FROM dbo.C;

Name: insert-output
Sql: INSERT INTO dbo.T (Id, Name) OUTPUT inserted.Id, inserted.Name VALUES (1, N'KeepCase'), (2, N'Other');

Name: update-output
Sql: UPDATE dbo.T SET a = 1, longName = N'KeepCase' OUTPUT inserted.a, deleted.a WHERE Id = 1 OPTION (RECOMPILE);

Name: delete-top
Sql: DELETE TOP (2) FROM dbo.T OUTPUT deleted.Id, deleted.Name WHERE Id > 0;

Name: merge-tail
Sql: MERGE TOP (2) dbo.T AS t USING dbo.S AS s ON t.Id = s.Id WHEN MATCHED AND s.Id > 0 THEN UPDATE SET t.Name = s.Name WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (Id, Name) VALUES (s.Id, s.Name) OUTPUT inserted.Id, deleted.Name OPTION (RECOMPILE);

Name: cursor
Sql: DECLARE c CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR SELECT Id, Name FROM dbo.T WHERE Id > 0;

Name: if-while-try
Sql: IF @a > 0 BEGIN WHILE @a > 0 BEGIN SET @a = @a - 1; END; END ELSE BEGIN TRY PRINT N'KeepCase'; END TRY BEGIN CATCH PRINT ERROR_MESSAGE(); END CATCH

Name: transaction-label
Sql: BEGIN TRAN;\nretry: SET @a = 1; PRINT @a; COMMIT TRAN; GOTO retry;

Name: function-table
Sql: CREATE FUNCTION dbo.f (@a int, @b int) RETURNS @r TABLE (Id int, Name nvarchar(50)) AS BEGIN INSERT INTO @r VALUES (@a, N'KeepCase'); RETURN; END;

Name: inline-function
Sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION dbo.f (@a int) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (SELECT Id, Name FROM dbo.T WHERE Id = @a);

Name: alter-view
Sql: ALTER VIEW dbo.v (Id, Name) WITH SCHEMABINDING AS SELECT Id, Name FROM dbo.T;

Name: temporal-table
Sql: CREATE TABLE dbo.HistoryT (Id int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, StartAt datetime2 GENERATED ALWAYS AS ROW START NOT NULL, EndAt datetime2 GENERATED ALWAYS AS ROW END NOT NULL, PERIOD FOR SYSTEM_TIME (StartAt, EndAt)) WITH (SYSTEM_VERSIONING = ON);

Name: ddl-trigger
Sql: CREATE TRIGGER ddl_guard ON DATABASE FOR CREATE_TABLE, ALTER_TABLE AS BEGIN PRINT N'KeepCase'; END;

Name: logon-trigger
Sql: CREATE TRIGGER login_guard ON ALL SERVER FOR LOGON AS BEGIN PRINT N'KeepCase'; END;

Name: dynamic-execute
Sql: EXEC sys.sp_executesql N'SELECT @a, @b', N'@a int, @b int', @a = 1, @b = 2;

Name: comment-boundary
Sql: SELECT a, -- KeepCase\nb FROM dbo.T WHERE a = 1 /* KeepCase */ AND b = 2;

Name: multiline-literal
Sql: SELECT N'KeepCase\nLiteral' AS Value;

Name: compute-legacy
Sql: SELECT a FROM dbo.T ORDER BY a COMPUTE SUM(a) BY a;
